characters.name: Miss Nova
characters.appearance: Silver humanoid robot with a metallic body and visible joints. It has glowing blue eyes and a smooth, featureless face aside from a moving mouth.

characters.name: Priya
characters.appearance: Young woman, medium build, fair complexion. She has dark hair tied back and wears round wire-rimmed glasses.

characters.name: Anjali
characters.appearance: Young woman, medium build, fair complexion. She has long dark hair worn loose.

scenes.supernova_script:
Priya says: I am having a doubt.
Miss Nova says: Say, 'I have a doubt'. I listen to you speak and correct you live.
Priya says: I didn't knew that.
Miss Nova says: Say, 'I didn't know that'. With 'did', we always use the root verb.
Priya says: You teach very nice.
Miss Nova says: Say, 'You teach very well'. You learn English by speaking it, just like your mother tongue.
scenes.scene_summary:
- Converts translation drill into live correction loop
- Lands beat c (speak, don't type) and beat g (logic explained)
- Lands beat f (mother tongue reframe)

- Lands beat a (personalization)
